note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: How AI could bring Mayo-quality health care to everyone
items.blurb: Mayo Clinic and Microsoft are fine-tuning a frontier model on clinical data, with plans to share it broadly.

items.title: Goldman Sachs picks China stocks poised to benefit from a new wave of AI-related hardware exports
items.blurb: Analysts see Chinese AI hardware suppliers gaining as export demand shifts, a read on how compute supply chains are realigning.

items.title: Anthropic revenue reportedly jumps to more than $11.5 billion in second quarter
items.blurb: Preliminary Q2 revenue of $11.5B, up from $4.73B in Q1 and $787M a year earlier, ahead of a possible IPO.

items.title: Inflation moderated as Intel and Nvidia fueled the AI trade in last week's market
items.blurb: Chip names led a record rally as traders dialed back September rate-hike odds to roughly one-in-three.

items.title: Gen Z is building an AI-resistant college backup plan
items.blurb: Young workers are shifting toward skilled trades, betting manual work is harder for AI to automate.

items.title: "There's no point": AI forces college students to rethink their major
items.blurb: Employers now weight AI literacy and judgment over major-specific training, pushing colleges to redesign programs.

items.title: College loses its monopoly on the American Dream
items.blurb: Degree debt plus AI-thinned entry-level hiring is weakening the assumed payoff of a bachelor's degree.

items.title: U.S. to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race with China
items.blurb: Draft State Department letter to 35 AI Opportunity Statement signatories would press allies to limit Chinese AI cooperation.

items.title: Nvidia eyes investing $3 billion in SoftBank's SB Energy under OpenAI data center deal, Information says
items.blurb: Chipmaker would take an equity stake in the power developer building OpenAI's planned Ohio campus, deepening circular AI financing.

items.title: OpenAI sheds senior execs in pre-IPO refresh
items.blurb: Chief revenue officer exits within a year, following departures of OpenAI's ethics, safety-systems and futurist leads.

items.title: AI's infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged - and harder to track
items.blurb: Debt financing is spreading through the data-center supply chain, making the buildout's true leverage harder for investors to see.

items.title: Data breaches surge in 2026 as AI plays a growing role in cyberattacks
items.blurb: Breach counts are climbing as attackers use AI tooling, with malicious-insider incidents also rising this year.

items.title: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.blurb: Revenue chief Denise Dresser exits days after Brad Lightcap, pressuring OpenAI's stability story before a historic listing.

items.title: Open-source AI faces more government scrutiny
items.blurb: Open-weight models escaped the latest US AI framework but may not stay outside federal review as capability rises.

items.title: Arm co-founder Hermann Hauser's AI warning: The revolution is real, but so is the bubble risk
items.blurb: A chip-industry founder argues AI's underlying shift is genuine while financing structures around it look overextended.

items.title: Anthropic sees AI risks rising, no plan to release stronger "Model 2"
items.blurb: Anthropic says an internal model exceeds Mythos but will not ship externally, the second lab to withhold on risk grounds.

items.title: China's Z.ai holds GLM 5.3 release over hacking risks
items.blurb: Z.ai delays GLM-5.3 open weights two weeks after the model scored 84.5% on the CyberGym vulnerability benchmark.

items.title: Goldman's latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
items.blurb: Goldman helped arrange Nvidia and Intel financing, including a $500 billion multi-bank effort to fund datacenter construction.

items.title: OpenAI CFO Friar tells investors that enterprise business now bigger than consumer by revenue
items.blurb: Enterprise passed consumer revenue months ahead of OpenAI's own forecast of year-end parity, ahead of a planned IPO.

items.title: Jane Street took $15 billion hit in July tied to Situational Awareness, AI selloff, sources say
items.blurb: A large trading loss tied to AI-linked positions shows how concentrated the AI trade has become.

items.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
items.blurb: The position came via Nvidia's xAI investment, deepening chip-vendor entanglement with its own AI customers.

items.title: American copper processing is seeing renewed interest from startups and investors
items.blurb: Data-center demand is pulling capital into domestic copper refining, most of which currently happens in overseas smelters.

items.title: An inside look at SK Hynix's $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea
items.blurb: The top high-bandwidth memory maker commits $720 billion to new fabs, tying AI supply to a single national buildout.

items.title: This Chinese firm has topped Micron and Kioxia in shipments of crucial NAND memory chips
items.blurb: A Chinese manufacturer leads NAND shipments, a shift in the memory supply chain that AI data centers depend on.
